kelly_marketing: Quick sync — target announce next Mon 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link, staging docs URL, a one-line benchmark stat for the hero, canary + ramp timeline, and who demos the webinar (30m).

jordan_growth: Promo plan: email ~5m after full rollout, social posts at +10m, webinar promo at +1h. Need approval on copy by EOD today.

sam_eng: Changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/512 (sha `ea4b1f7`). Canary plan: 09:00 canary 10m, 30% at 09:10, 70% at 09:25, full at 09:40. Fallback image is `release-phoenix-2026-legacy`. Ops on standby.

priya_docs: Staging docs ready: https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/release-phoenix. I'll add migration steps and an abbreviated quickstart. Marketing: paste the canonical staging link into the announcement draft when ready.

nico_research: Quick benchmark line: "Phoenix cuts per-token cost by ~2x on 16k-context workloads while reducing p95 latency ~45%." I'll run one final validation and confirm numbers by 07:30 PT tomorrow.

kelly_marketing: That works. Webinar: Evan lead demo? Priya does migration walkthrough, Nico handles benchmark Qs. Jordan will own registration landing page. Evan?

ev an_pm: Happy to lead. I'll prep a 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. Adding runbook/rollback to my checklist.

sam_eng: Runbook snippet for ops: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/reinference --to-revision=5` and health-check: `curl -sS https://health.prod.redwood.dev/model-route | jq .p95`. Add a post-deploy check to validate KV-cache hit rate.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment release-phoenix start=5601234500 canary_window=600s full_rollout=5601235200 CI: all green. :white_check_mark:

kelly_marketing: Proposed publish timeline: 09:00 PT canary, 09:40 full, 09:45 blog + docs link live, 09:50 email, 11:00 webinar (live). I'll drop announcement draft here by EOD for sign-off. Tagging final items: merged changelog, staging docs URL, confirmed benchmark number, runbook + rollback command, webinar slide deck. Ping if anything changes. :sparkles:
